title: App logins
description: People who can sign in to the app, and what each can see and change. Workers without a login are managed under Staff.
newDescription: They sign in with their phone number and a temporary password you give them, then choose their own.

roleHints.admin: Can do everything, including managing employees and voiding sales.
roleHints.employee: Can only use the sections you allow below.

moduleHints.production: Daily production, brick stock, brick types
moduleHints.staff: Workers, daily attendance, wages and advances

form.name: Full name
form.phoneHint: Used to sign in. Must be unique.
form.emailHint: Also works for sign-in, and receives alerts.
form.alertsHint: Each person chooses which alerts they get, and how (app, email, SMS, WhatsApp), on their Notifications page.
form.pinSignIn: Allow quick sign-in with a PIN
form.pinSignInHint: They can set a 6-digit PIN on a device after signing in there with their password. Turning this off removes their PINs at once.

temporaryPassword.title: Temporary password
temporaryPassword.description: Give this to {name}. It is shown only once and works for 3 days. They will choose their own password when they first sign in.

actions.resetPasswordBody: They will be signed out everywhere and must sign in with a new temporary password.
actions.disableBody: They will be signed out immediately and cannot sign in until you enable the account again. Their records stay.
actions.enableBody: They will be able to sign in again with their existing password.
actions.signOutEverywhereBody: Any phone or computer they are signed in on will need to sign in again.

emptyBody: Add the people who work at the plant so they can record production and sales.

photo.title: Photo
photo.hint: Optional. JPG, PNG or WebP. It is resized automatically.

errors.invalid: That file is not a photo, or it is too large.
errors.full: Storage is full. Ask your admin.
errors.failed: The photo could not be saved. Please try again.
